narrative.details:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
narrative.objectives: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home.I have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
narrative.requestItemsText: For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves.And it's funny...
